stem:
Dev draws the ray shown in the figure. It starts at point A and passes through points B and C in that order.

Which label correctly names the ray?

options.text: Ray BA, because B and A both lie on the path.
Point A is produced by the ray, so any letter order is fine.
Ray AB or ray AC, because the starting point A comes first, then a point on the path.
Line ABC, treating the figure as a two-way line with no starting point.

teacher.key_rationale: A ray is named with its starting point first, then any point on its path: AB or AC. BA starts at B and omits the given start. The start is not produced by the ray. Calling it line ABC changes the object.
teacher.figure_note: Ray starting at A through B and C.

mx_swap.reason: Operation-confusion CWO invents squaring a starting point; not sayable with the stem objects. Kept condition_omission, relationship_reversal, scope_error.
